object.attr: analysis: such a condition matches no object, so a misspelt name turns a check off and the gate still passes (CF-C22). Rules files have no editing tool. requirement-type is checked as the attribute it matches (review Q6).
object.description: If a rule condition names an attribute, other than has-outgoing-link, that the document's manifest doesn't define, Mellon shall report RULEFILE_UNKNOWN_ATTRIBUTE, taking requirement-type as the name RequirementType.
